channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: JetBrains Mellum 2.1: 12B Apache-2.0 MoE coding model you can self-host
item.description: JetBrains shipped Mellum 2.1, a 12B-total / 2.5B-active mixture-of-experts coding model under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face; RL post-training inside real repos took SWE-bench Verified from 2.0 to 47.0, with GGUF builds for local inference.

item.title: WoW Forever unveiled at BlizzCon 2026: horizontal Classic+ expansion detailed
item.description: BlizzCon 2026 reveal positions WoW Forever as a permanent third branch: revamped and new zones, three raids, a new battleground, and the Skyborne elves at level 60.

item.title: ServiceNow launches EmployeeWorks no-code agent platform
item.description: ServiceNow launched EmployeeWorks, a no-code platform letting employees build their own agents, with a ToolSmith dev environment and pre-built research and scheduling assistants.

item.title: Codex Harness open-sourced by OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI open-sourced the Codex Harness execution layer (Apache-2.0), the agent core behind Codex, so teams can embed its task understanding, tool calling, and human-approval loop in their own software.

item.title: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 Bolt open models for local AI agents
item.description: Nvidia released two open-weight Bolt models for local agents: a 74B-A9B MoE fitting 24GB via 2-bit quantization, out now on Hugging Face with Ollama and llama.cpp support, plus a 4GB E4B model due Oct. 23.

item.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG + Unstoppable Project Update: Foundry has joined the party
item.description: Renegade announces Foundry VTT as a pledge option alongside Fantasy Grounds, Roll20, and Alchemy for the Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG, with an October 2026 VTT launch and the bundle free for top-tier backers.

item.title: Phi-4 Mini Reasoning in GGUF: a 3.8B local reasoner lands on Modelers.cn
item.description: Community GGUF repack of Microsoft's 3.8B Phi-4-mini-reasoning puts the MIT-licensed reasoning model on llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio at roughly 4-8 GB RAM; a third-party repack, not an official Microsoft release.

item.title: NVIDIA releases Dory1.0-4B: looped latent-recurrent open-weight model with GGUF builds
item.description: NVIDIA published Dory1.0-4B on October 16, a 4B looped (latent-recurrent) model whose shared layer block re-runs per token to trade compute for quality, with 256K context and official GGUF builds for local inference.

item.title: BitCPM4-1B: a ternary 1.58-bit 1B model in GGUF
item.description: OpenBMB's ternary-quantized 1B model lands as a third-party GGUF build, aimed at llama.cpp-class runtimes on CPUs and edge hardware.

item.title: llama.cpp adopts semantic versioning: v0.4.1 breaks old flags
item.description: llama.cpp's latest tagged release v0.4.1 (Sept 14, 2026) adds Maple 20B-A1B, Tencent Hy 4 and Spark2.5 support, and replaces --mmap/--mlock/--direct-io with a single --load-mode flag — check your scripts.

item.title: Oct 15 AI roundup: Builder.io Agent-Native, Meta Immersive Web SDK 1.0, PilotDeck 2.0
item.description: Builder.io open-sourced the MIT-licensed Agent-Native framework where agents and UIs share typed actions; Meta shipped Immersive Web SDK 1.0 with an MCP server so coding agents can build and test WebXR scenes; OpenBMB released PilotDeck 2.0, a model-agnostic agent harness for office work.

item.title: Cadence launches agentic AI design tool to support chip design and verification
item.description: Cadence launches ChipStack AI Super Agent, a multi-agent harness that automates front-end chip design and verification across its EDA tools; Altera, Nvidia, Qualcomm and Tenstorrent are named as early adopters.

item.title: BAND for Developers: shared hub tracking every active AI coding agent
item.description: BAND's new desktop app gives teams one workspace to see what every running coding agent is doing, replacing terminal-and-tab hunting.

item.title: Ruflo meta-harness breakdown: missions, federation, and the model-plus-harness lesson
item.description: A builder's teardown of Ruflo's Oct-13 meta-harness release: mission-style Mods that run research-to-test loops, federated multi-machine swarms with PII gating and trust scoring, self-learning SONA memory, and the core argument that agent failures are harness failures — memory, routing, approvals, observability — not model failures.

item.title: Blizzard: Forever classes keep Classic kits, but 'too simple' specs gain mechanics
item.description: In a TechRadar interview, the Forever team says classes will stay simpler than retail but gain new mechanics where vanilla kits were barebones, using the beta's class depth as the benchmark.

item.title: Pi 1.0 Coding Agent: Open-Source Release Cuts Tokens 40%
item.description: MIT-licensed open-source terminal coding-agent harness from Earendil: provider-agnostic across 15+ model backends, a Codemode system where the model writes JavaScript to invoke tools instead of listing them in the prompt (claimed ~40% token reduction), MCP support, and hooks to local Ollama/llama.cpp endpoints; released alongside an October wave of agent updates from Claude Code, OpenCode, Copilot and GPT-6.1 Sol.

item.title: Refreshed practical guide to LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning on consumer GPUs
item.description: A refreshed hands-on guide to fine-tuning with LoRA and QLoRA on consumer hardware: VRAM requirements per model size, dataset formatting, and a full SFTTrainer training-script walkthrough.

item.title: Third-party GGUF build of Sarashina2.2 1B for local inference
item.description: A community GGUF repackaging of SB Intuitions' compact 1B text model, aimed at laptop and edge-box text-generation experiments through llama.cpp-style runtimes.

item.title: AI Coding Agents Add 30% More Code, Not Software
item.description: October 2026 coding-agent release roundup: Copilot CLI computer-use preview, Claude Code Mods, OpenCode v1.19, Google's MCP Toolbox Java SDK, and a Microsoft Copilot redesign all shipped in the same two-week window.

item.title: Liquid AI ships open-weight LFM2.5-24B-A2B for on-device agents
item.description: Liquid AI released the final LFM2.5 model: a 24B-parameter / 2.45B-active open-weight MoE reasoning model with day-one GGUF and MLX support, benchmarked specifically for on-device agent workflows.

item.title: WoW Forever: alts central, retail races not planned, shaman tanks only a discussion
item.description: Pre-launch interview details: alts and the Legacy system are the long-term loop, account-wide bank is under consideration, retail races are not planned, and the roadmap stays on Kalimdor/Eastern Kingdoms for the first years.

item.title: Infested Buildings: four 5e adventures converted to Foundry VTT
item.description: Hod Publishing is converting Toby Lancaster's four established 5e adventures into ready-to-run Foundry VTT modules, with the campaign already funded and chasing stretch goals for soundtracks.

item.title: POCO F7 as a 32K-context LLM server: complete benchmark log
item.description: Unvarnished log of building llama.cpp natively on a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 phone and turning it into a private LLM server, with every command, failure, and throughput number measured on-device.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever pre-purchase guide for the November 4 launch
item.description: Pixel Herald rounds up WoW: Forever's November 4 launch, Battle.net pre-purchase upgrade tiers, and what Blizzard has confirmed about the Classic+ rebuild.

item.title: Cairn: A Work Harness for AI Coding Agents — Plans in Git, Truth in Your Tracker, Nothing Done Without Evidence
item.description: Cairn is an open-source (MIT) work harness for AI coding agents — a Claude Code plugin with 39 slash commands plus a TypeScript MCP server exposing 87 typed tools — built around one law: the issue tracker is the single source of truth, with phases mirrored into the tracker, goal-backward verification, plan-versus-tracker drift math, and a ship gate that refuses to proceed when they disagree.

item.title: Xyntetik-Runner 1.2.0 launches
item.description: New Apache-2.0 local inference engine ships as a single-file executable with predictive hardware fitting and schema enforcement aimed at reliable agentic workflows on Mac, Linux, and Windows.

item.title: DXC and LangChain partner on governed agentic AI for mission-critical IT
item.description: DXC Technology partners with LangChain to build governed agent harnesses on the LangGraph runtime and LangSmith tooling for mission-critical IT operations; DXC says its OASIS platform, already in production, cut incident resolution time 95% across 500 measured use cases.

item.title: Xcode 26.3 RC brings agentic coding to the IDE: Claude Agent and Codex integrated via MCP
item.description: Apple's Xcode 26.3 release candidate adds built-in agentic coding, with Anthropic's Claude Agent, OpenAI's Codex, and custom agents via MCP able to read and modify project files, build apps, and run tests directly in the IDE.

item.title: Cognitum One releases Ruflo, open-source agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex
item.description: Open-source meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex that organizes agents into queen-led swarms with persistent shared memory, plus mission-driven Mods and a single control plane; the release claims 74,000 GitHub stars and 12.5M npm downloads.

item.title: Introducing Superfluid: the local-AI native LLM server for multi-agent inference
item.description: Open-source Apache-2.0 local inference server built for many agents sharing one machine: interactive requests preempt background agent work, every token is logged so crashed sessions resume, and it serves llama.cpp, MLX and BaseRT behind OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama APIs.

item.title: OceanGPT-7B in GGUF: a marine-science specialist LLM you can run locally
item.description: A GGUF repack of OceanGPT-7B, a Qwen-7B-based model tuned for marine and ocean science, bringing a rare domain-specialist open model into llama.cpp's reach on modest local hardware.

item.title: 46M-parameter model pre-trained from scratch on inference-only NPUs, released on Hugging Face
item.description: Concrete proof-of-concept that backprop training can run on chips sold as inference-only: VIDRAFT pre-trained a 46M-parameter model end-to-end on a first-gen NPU with no GPU involved, and published the weights plus comparison materials on Hugging Face as the validation artifact for their NPU-native acceleration stack.

item.title: CodeGem: a Gemini/Gemma coding harness for SuperQode
item.description: New open coding-agent harness tuned for Gemini and local Gemma via Ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp, with a durable session loop and optional semantic retrieval.

item.title: 2026 blueprint for fine-tuning LLMs with PEFT on private codebases
item.description: A practical PEFT playbook covering LoRA, QLoRA, and DoRA with working code examples, aimed at tuning LLMs on private codebases.

item.title: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B: 24B-param MoE, 2B active per pass
item.description: Liquid AI's newest open-weight MoE activates only 2B of 24B params per forward pass, aimed at single-GPU local agentic workloads.

item.title: Deploying LLMs locally: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM and TGI compared
item.description: Fresh hands-on walkthrough covering all four runtimes end to end: Ollama quick-start, llama.cpp builds and Q4_K_M quantization, vLLM serving with AWQ/GPTQ and LoRA adapters, plus TGI, with runnable configs for each.

item.title: Harness acquires Augment Code, launches Cosmos software-factory agent
item.description: Harness bought coding-agent startup Augment Code and rolled out Cosmos: per-ticket agent fleets that plan, code, test, and open PRs from isolated VMs, with Augment's Code Context Engine for repo awareness.

item.title: Blizzard rules out adding existing expansion races to WoW: Forever
item.description: Blizzard tells TechRadar it has no plans to bring goblin, vulpera, or haranir races to WoW: Forever, instead building an independent timeline off the Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom campaign — with the all-new Skyborne race as the sole exception.

item.title: Agentic AI roundup: Google open-sources self-improving agent harness RRSI
item.description: Google Research open-sources RRSI, a framework that lets LLM agents rewrite their own prompts, tools, and memory — Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises from 74.2% to 80.2%; also notes a 115 ms local routing model for agent tool-selection on an RTX 3090.

item.title: The Agentic Coding Kit: a senior-engineer's AI coding setup as a config pack
item.description: Indie launch (Oct 12): 34 drop-in files packaging a senior engineer's agent setup — behavior-controlling CLAUDE.md, scoped permission allow/deny lists, git hooks that run lint/typecheck/tests before broken agent commits land, and subagent delegation playbooks — aimed at Claude Code and Cursor users; one-time paid download.
